verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents a first-party, Snowflake-managed MCP server that lets AI agents securely retrieve data without separate infrastructure. It can be configured to serve Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, Cortex Agents, custom tools and SQL execution as tools, and a probe confirms the official docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, and evidence on client connection and authentication setup details.
